shots.focal_element: Meta infinity mark, very low contrast against a near-black background
shots.transition_other: video start (anchors give no transition into the first shot)
shots.what_happens: A single held frame of the large Meta infinity mark, dim grey on black, fading up from darkness as a cold open.
shots.build_rebuild: Render the brand mark SVG centred at about 60% frame width on a near-black background at roughly 15% opacity and fade its opacity up over the shot's 0.46 s.

shots.focal_element: Rendered Meta Quest 3 headset front with floating controllers, then the headset in three-quarter view with the headline over it
shots.typography: Clean geometric/humanist sans, dark ink on pale gradient. 'Introducing' small medium weight above a larger semibold 'Meta Quest 3' lockup, sentence case, normal tracking; later 'Reimagined and redesigned' semibold sentence case centred over the product. Possibly Meta's brand sans (Optimistic) - low confidence.
shots.what_happens: The Meta mark brightens and lightens to grey, then the camera zooms through into a tight close-up of the headset front sensors on a pastel pink-to-blue gradient; it pulls back to reveal the headset floating centre with two controllers flanking it while 'Introducing / Meta Quest 3' resolves from a motion-blurred smear. Around 4.0 s everything smears left with directional motion blur and the headset reappears rotated three-quarter with 'Reimagined' then 'and redesigned' appended word-by-word; the shot ends as the faceplate lifts off into an exploded view of the internals.
shots.build_rebuild: Scale the logo up past camera into a 3D product render close-up, pull back to a centred headset with controllers left and right, blur-in a two-line title (small kicker over bold product name), then exit with a horizontal motion-blur push and append 'Reimagined' + 'and redesigned' word-by-word over a rotated product view before animating the faceplate upward on the Y axis.

shots.focal_element: Exploded view of the headset: faceplate, camera bracket and internal boards separated vertically, with the headline sitting in the gap
shots.typography: Large semibold sans, sentence case, dark ink, normal tracking, centred and inserted between the exploded layers so components sit above and below it.
shots.what_happens: The exploded headset holds with a slow drift as the top layers continue to separate slightly; 'From the inside out' sits in the gap between the floating faceplate parts and the open chassis.
shots.build_rebuild: Stack separated product layers (faceplate, bracket, board, chassis) with a slow eased Y-separation and place a centred semibold headline in the vertical gap between the upper and lower layers.

shots.focal_element: Two headsets side by side from below/behind (Quest 2 left, Quest 3 right) with the '40% slimmer' stat centred between them
shots.transition_other: motion-blurred entry: the stat '40' arrives smeared and a blurred element sweeps in from the left (whip-like, not classified by code)
on_screen_text: As compared to Quest 2 excluding the facial interfaces.
shots.typography: Stat '40% slimmer' in large semibold sans, lowercase word after the numeral, dark ink; footnote disclaimer in small light/regular grey sans centred near the bottom edge.
shots.what_happens: A side-by-side comparison of the old and new headset; the number '40' blurs in and resolves to '40% slimmer' with a footnote disclaimer. Around 10.5 s the facial interfaces drop in from below with motion blur, the text clears, and at the end both headsets rotate quickly with heavy motion blur into the next angle.
shots.build_rebuild: Place two product renders in left/right halves, blur-in a centred stat label between them with a small footnote at the bottom, then slide the facial-interface parts up from below the frame and exit by rotating both renders with a motion-blur whip.

shots.focal_element: Quest 2 (left) and Quest 3 (right) in side profile with straps, facing each other to show the depth difference
shots.transition_other: continuation of the motion-blurred rotation that ends s004 (code classified as other)
shots.what_happens: Both headsets hang in profile on the pastel gradient, angled toward each other, with a very slow drift so the slimmer front profile of the new model is visible; no text.
shots.build_rebuild: Show two product renders in profile, left one angled down-right and right one angled up-left, on the same pastel gradient, with a slow 1-2% drift for the 1.3 s hold.
